title: Part 5 介系詞還是連接詞
summary: because 還是 because of？although 還是 despite？看後面接什麼。

steps.title: 重點觀念
body: 這是多益超級常考的題型：意思一樣的字，有的後面接名詞（介系詞），有的後面接句子（連接詞）。
例如「因為」：because ＋ 句子（because it rained）；because of ＋ 名詞（because of the rain）。
「雖然」：although ＋ 句子；despite ＋ 名詞。「在…期間」：while ＋ 句子；during ＋ 名詞。

steps.title: 解題技巧
steps.tip: 判斷方法：空格後面有沒有「主詞＋動詞」？有就是句子，用連接詞。

items.en: The game was canceled because of the rain.
Although it was raining, we went hiking.
items.zh: 雖然在下雨，我們還是去爬山。

items.en: Despite the high price, the tickets sold out quickly.
items.zh: 儘管價格很高，票還是很快就賣完了。

items.en: Please do not talk during the movie.
items.zh: 電影播放期間請勿交談。

steps.title: 模擬練習
steps.intro: 先看題目，再作答。答錯會再出一題類似的。

questions.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
questions.explanation: the rain 是名詞，用 because of。
questions.sentence: The game was canceled ___ the rain.

questions.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
questions.explanation: it was raining 是句子，而且前後相反，用 Although。
questions.sentence: ___ it was raining, we went hiking.
questions.zh: 雖然在下雨，我們還是去爬山。

questions.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
questions.explanation: the movie 是名詞，用 during。
questions.sentence: Please do not talk ___ the movie.
questions.zh: 電影播放期間請勿交談。

questions.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
questions.explanation: the high price 是名詞，意思相反，用 Despite。
questions.sentence: ___ the high price, the tickets sold out quickly.
questions.zh: 儘管價格很高，票還是很快賣完。

questions.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
questions.explanation: he was waiting 是句子，用 while。
questions.sentence: Mr. Chen read the newspaper ___ he was waiting for the train.
questions.zh: 陳先生在等火車的時候看報紙。

questions.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
questions.explanation: there were no customers 是句子，用 because。
questions.sentence: The store closed early ___ there were no customers.
questions.zh: 因為沒有客人，這家店提早關門。

similar.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
similar.explanation: the storm 是名詞，用 because of。
similar.sentence: The flight was delayed ___ the storm.

similar.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
similar.explanation: he was tired 是句子，用 Although。
similar.sentence: ___ he was tired, he finished the report.
similar.zh: 雖然他很累，還是完成了報告。

similar.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
similar.explanation: the long speech 是名詞，用 during。
similar.sentence: Many people fell asleep ___ the long speech.
similar.zh: 很多人在冗長的演講中睡著了。

similar.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
similar.explanation: the bad weather 是名詞，用 Despite。
similar.sentence: ___ the bad weather, the event was a success.
similar.zh: 儘管天氣不好，活動還是很成功。

similar.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
similar.explanation: she is driving 是句子，用 while。
similar.sentence: She listens to music ___ she is driving.
similar.zh: 她開車的時候會聽音樂。

similar.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
similar.explanation: it was too cold 是句子，用 because。
similar.sentence: We stayed home ___ it was too cold.

questions.prompt: 多益實戰：選出最適合的答案
questions.explanation: the delay in shipping 是名詞片語，意思相反，用 Despite。
questions.sentence: ___ the delay in shipping, the products arrived in time for the sale.
questions.zh: 儘管運送延遲，產品還是及時在特賣前送到。

questions.prompt: 多益實戰：選出最適合的答案
questions.explanation: they are in the factory 是句子，用 while。
questions.sentence: Visitors must wear a badge ___ they are in the factory.
questions.zh: 訪客在工廠內必須配戴識別證。
